pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries within 300 seconds of an initial order ticket on the same asset to avoid correlated stop-outs.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmation via a 1-minute order flow imbalance filter and absolute spread compression below 30 points prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit crosses +$4.00 to guarantee net-positive execution.
